Export the selection of a refused read

Source: R/exports.R
soil_export_from_error.Rd

A synchronous read above the limit (limits$max_sync_observations) raises a soilhub_load_limit_error that carries its selection. This submits the same selection as an export: the observations in the layout of the refused read for soil_observations(), the features (content = "features") for soil_features(). It is the manual form of too_large = "export", for an error caught earlier.

Usage

soil_export_from_error(soil = soil_session(), error, format = "gpkg", ...)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

error

The soilhub_load_limit_error of a read (channel = "sync"). Client-side: not sent to the API.

format

The export format (see soil_export()). API field format.

...

Other arguments of soil_export() (content, layout, wait, timeout, dir, ...; a selection argument given here replaces the error's). Each is sent, or not, as described for soil_export() (API fields of POST /exports, or client-side).

Value

A soil_export (see soil_export()).

Details

Rights: soil:read.

See also

Other exports: soil_export(), soil_export_read(), soil_export_status()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
e <- tryCatch(soil_observations(soil, datasets = "wosis_points"),
              soilhub_load_limit_error = function(e) e)
x <- soil_export_from_error(soil, e, format = "csv")
obs <- soil_export_read(x)
} # }
